overall: The AG found the July 19, 2011 executive session and the later resolution vote lawful, but found the executive session minutes incomplete and ordered them revised within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission's July 19, 2011 executive session on litigation strategy was unlawful.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by meeting in executive session on July 19, 2011 to discuss litigation strategy with respect to the resolution that was subsequently approved on September 27, 2011.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a resolution drafted in executive session and adopted September 27, 2011 without public comment or debate was unlawful.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, it was permissible for the Commission to vote on the resolution language in executive session.

allegations.summary: Review of the July 19, 2011 executive session minutes found they lacked a sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion leading to the adopted language.
allegations.key_passage: The July 19, 2011 minutes do not include a sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion that led to the language adopted by the Commission.

remedy: Revise the July 19, 2011 executive session minutes within 30 days of receipt of the letter to include a summary of the Commission's discussion.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
